# PIXEL RUN

> PIXEL RUN is a browser-based endless runner and 2D platform game.

## Play

- Game: https://jimm144.github.io/pixel-run/
- Source code: https://github.com/Jimm144/pixel-run

## Game facts

- The player runs automatically through four biomes: jungle, desert, tundra and neon city.
- Controls include jumping, double jumping, diving and a speed boost.
- Gameplay includes enemies, coins, gems, shield, jump shoes, triple jump and propeller power-ups.
- Combo scoring increases points from enemy stomps, coins, gems and power-ups.
- The combo multiplier reaches x10.
- Four daily quests track run or daily totals for coins, meters, score, enemies, power-ups and jumps.
- Special quests include clean runs, biome effects, simultaneous power-ups and reaching a x10 combo.
- Best run, last run and daily quest progress are stored in browser localStorage.

## Technical facts

- TypeScript, React, Vite and an HTML5 Canvas renderer.
- Music and sound effects use the Web Audio API.
- The project is licensed under GPL-3.0.
